messages:
Priya Shah: @here quick midweek async check-in — drop 1-2 lines: what you shipped yesterday, any blockers, and what you're focusing on today. I'll compile highlights for Friday sync :memo:
Marcus Chen: shipped the metrics dashboard PR yesterday, waiting on a couple of perf tests. No blockers, will work on pagination + doc updates today :rocket:
Lina Gomez: worked on rollout policy docs, hit an auth permission edge case when testing private deployments. Blocker: need an env that mirrors customer KMS setup. Can anyone in infra share a test key config? :thinking_face:
Tom B.: merged tiny bugfix for batching logic. Noted one flaky test that only fails on cuda12 runners — filed issue #412. Today: dive into CI flakes and try to repro locally. :wrench:
Olivia Park: paired with QA on chat prompt regressions, created a failing eval set. Blocker: need a short timeout increase in staging to capture longer responses. CC @Marcus for dashboard impact. :eyes:
Priya Shah: Lina — ping @Tom B. and @Hector-RestartBot for infra key config. Tom — assign me the flaky-test issue if you want a reviewer. Olivia — will approve the staging timeout if QA records the repro steps. :thumbsup:
Hector-RestartBot: CI: deployment pipeline for feature/realtime-batching completed, all checks passed. :white_check_mark:
Marcus Chen: Lina — I can share a sanitized KMS config sample. DM me and I'll drop the snippet. Also verifying dashboard latency numbers for larger seq len today.
Lina Gomez: Thanks Marcus, sending DM now. Also tagging @James for any privacy/legal notes around KMS samples.
James Wong: Lina — from compliance side we prefer a mock KMS config with clear disclaimers. Marcus, happy to review the sample before it's published internally.
Tom B.: quick ask — who can eyeball this log output?
Tom B.: ```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z ERROR runtime: kvcache miss for prefix=0x1a
stack: serve.go:221 -> batch.go:89 -> kvstore.go:133
```
Tom B.: suspect race when cache miss triggers fallback path. Any hints?
Marcus Chen: @Tom B. try toggling continuous_batch=false locally and repro. I had similar traces when batch window overlapped evictions.
Olivia Park: FYI I pushed a small prompt fix, will open a PR in ~30m. If anyone's doing prompt evals today, please skip the old prompt set.
Priya Shah: Highlights for Friday update: - Dashboard PR merged (Marcus) - Rollout docs progress (Lina) - Batching fix in prod (Tom) - Eval test set for prompt regressions (Olivia) Keep notes short, I'll collate. Also any blockers that need escalation to eng-sre?
Lina Gomez: blocker escalated — need a staging KMS mirror to validate private deploys. Not urgent but would unblock rollout testing.
Priya Shah: Noted. I'll flag to eng-sre and request a low-priv mirror this afternoon.
James Wong: Also reminder: anyone touching customer keys or KMS samples, add the compliance checklist item in PR template. I can add a checkbox.
Hector-RestartBot: Incident alert (informational): scheduled infra maintenance tonight 23:00 UTC — short restarts expected, not expected to affect Dedicated pools.
Marcus Chen: thanks for the heads up Hector — I'll hold off large load tests until tomorrow.
Olivia Park: ack maintenance window. Will schedule prompt evals around that.
Priya Shah: Great team — thanks for the updates. If you need pairing on any blockers ping me or drop a quick DM. I'll post the compiled highlights by EOD. :sparkles:
